fact: MNT-Halan raised EGP 3.4 billion (USD 71.4 million) in its seventh securitised bond issuance, managed by CIB and CI Capital under an EGP 8 billion programme approved by Egypt's FRA, after a USD 49 million corporate bond in May.
title: Egyptian fintech unicorn MNT-Halan raises $71.4m via 7th securitised bond issuance
